papers.title: Sidecar: Training-Free Semantic Reuse for Character-Consistent Free-form Visual Storytelling
papers.authors: Sibo Dong, Sarah Adel Bargal
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Georgetown University, Washington, D.C., USA
papers.intro: Sidecar是一种无需训练的即插即用语义增强模块，通过从初始角色描述中提取逐层隐藏表示并作为临时语义标记注入后续提示词的文本编码过程，在不修改基础扩散模型架构的前提下恢复缺失的身份语义，从而提升自由形式视觉故事生成中的角色一致性和提示-图像对齐。

papers.title: DINOcular: Self-Supervised Visuospatial Representations
papers.authors: Farkhat Almukhamedov, Sami Azirar, Hermann Blum
papers.tags: depth estimation, vision transformer, semantic segmentation, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: University of Bonn（波恩大学，Robot Perception and Learning Lab）
papers.intro: 本文提出DINOcular，一种自监督RGB-D视觉-空间表示学习框架，通过3D旋转位置编码（3D RoPE）实现patch间几何融合、通过轻量级深度嵌入实现patch内几何融合，并结合语义自蒸馏与多视角一致性损失，使模型在保持语义迁移能力的同时显著提升3D几何感知能力。

papers.title: CODE: Cross-Modal Calibration and Dynamic Suppression for Open World Object Detection
papers.authors: Hao Xu, Zhaoning Shi, Hehe Jin, Bo Ma
papers.tags: object detection, CLIP, multimodal learning, image classification
papers.affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology
papers.intro: CODE是一个统一的推理时框架，通过跨模态联合置信度校准、不确定性引导的通用目标性增强和基于置信度边距的动态异常值抑制三个互补组件，在开放世界目标检测中同时提升已知类和未知类目标的检测性能。

papers.title: PACE: A Unified Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Fast VLM Inference
papers.authors: Junjie Liu, Shengyuan Ye, Xu Chen
papers.tags: multimodal learning, vision transformer, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University; Power Dispatch Control Center, Guangdong Power Grid Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: PACE提出了一种无需训练的"压缩-提取"（Condense-and-Extract）统一推理框架，通过编码前的自适应像素压缩（APC）和编码后的动态双注意力提取（DDAE），同时加速视觉编码器和LLM，在仅保留10%视觉token的情况下保持93.8%的原始性能并实现3.1倍TTFT加速。

papers.title: Vision-centric generative AI models: A software-hardware perspective
papers.authors: Eleni Tselepi, Cristian Sestito, Shady Agwa, Themis Prodromakis
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Centre for Electronics Frontiers, Institute for Integrated Micro and Nano Systems, School of Engineering, The University of Edinburgh, UK
papers.intro: 本文从软件-硬件协同设计的视角，系统梳理了视觉生成式AI模型（VAE、GAN、扩散模型、自回归Transformer）与AI硬件加速器（GPU、TPU、FPGA、CIM、神经形态芯片）的并行演进历史，量化了模型参数成本与能效，并提出了"正确的模型运行在正确的硬件上服务于正确的应用"的协同设计路线图。

papers.title: SSMB: Self-Supervised Local Feature Detection under Motion Blur
papers.authors: Zhenjun Zhao, Fabio Bellavia, Wenting Wang, Fan Zhu, Jiajun Wu, Suryansh Kumar, Mingqiang Wei, Haoang Li, Javier Civera
papers.affiliations: University of Zaragoza, University of Palermo, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Tohoku University, Central South University, Texas A&M University, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.intro: SSMB提出了一种无需去模糊、无需手工检测器或外部伪标签的自监督关键点检测方法，通过引入局部可判别性增强模块和两阶段训练策略，在运动模糊图像上实现了超越现有稀疏关键点检测器的最先进性能。

papers.title: Ancient-Bench: A Comprehensive Multi-millennial, Multi-medium, and Multi-script Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Artifact Text Recognition
papers.authors: Hiuyi Cheng, Nuo Xu, Yuyi Zhang, Xuhan Zheng, Wei Pan, Jing Zhang, Dezhi Peng, Minghui Liao, Yihua Teng, Jihao Wu, Haoyu Ren, Lianwen Jin
papers.affiliations: South China University of Technology, Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd
papers.intro: 本文提出了Ancient-Bench，一个涵盖9种媒介类型、7种历史字体、跨越3000多年文字演化的综合性古代中文文物文字识别基准数据集，并定义了三种标准化标注协议，通过大量实验揭示了现有VLM和OCR模型在该任务上仍面临根本性挑战。

papers.title: Data-efficient crack quantification in lithium-ion cathodes using foundation model transfer
papers.authors: Thorsten Tegetmeyer-Kleine, Thomas Schmitt, Phillip Aquino, Christiane Rahe, Dirk Uwe Sauer, Weihan Li
papers.affiliations: RWTH Aachen University（亚琛工业大学）；Honda Research Institute USA, Inc.；Honda Research Institute Europe GmbH；Zenules GmbH；Forschungszentrum Juelich（于利希研究中心）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种数据高效的裂纹定量框架，通过冻结的自监督视觉Transformer编码器（DINOv3）结合轻量级可训练解码器（DeepLabV3+）和迭代模型辅助标注策略，以极少的专家标注实现了NMC阴极百兆像素SEM图像中三类裂纹（晶内、早期晶间、晚期晶间）的像素级分割和颗粒级形态学定量分析。

papers.title: ReViCo: Unveiling the Limitations of VLMs in Visual Text Understanding via Error Correction
papers.authors: Bojun Zhang, Junhong Liang, Feifei Zhai, Fengxian Ji, Yu Zhou
papers.tags: OCR, multimodal learning, visual question answering, image captioning
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems, Institute of Automation, CAS; School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Fanyu AI Laboratory, Zhongke Fanyu Technology Co., Ltd; Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
papers.intro: 本文提出了ReViCo（Real Visual Correction）基准，通过视觉文本纠错这一新任务系统评估了多种VLMs在视觉文本理解上的能力，揭示了当前模型与人类水平之间的显著差距，并提出了提示策略和强化学习训练两种范式来推动模型性能提升。

papers.title: How AI Experiences Art: Emergent Aesthetic Structure in a Self-Supervised Multimodal Embedding Space
papers.authors: Corey D. C. Heath
papers.affiliations: Independent Researcher, Phoenix, AZ, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出一个无需跨模态配对或人工标注的自监督多模态美学聚类框架，将文本、音频、图像和视频四种模态投影到共享256维嵌入空间，通过迭代聚类发现28个语义连贯的美学概念簇，并揭示了AI美学分类与人类情感标注之间的显著差异。

papers.title: Automated 2D and 3D Segmentation of AMD and DME Lesions in OCT
papers.authors: Lucia Sundberg, Zhihao Zhao, M. Ali Nasseri
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, 3D reconstruction, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: MAPS Lab, Technical University of Munich, Munich, Germany; University of Wisconsin-Madison, Madison, Wisconsin, USA
papers.intro: 本文构建并系统消融了四种基于U-Net的2D/3D OCT病变分割管线（AMD和DME各两种），在域内验证集上达到Dice 0.76-0.82，并通过代理指标框架在无病变级标注的外部临床队列OLIVES上评估了模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
papers.authors: Chuan Fang, Lingteng Qiu, Yixun Liang, Rui Chen, Kunming Luo, Zhaohua Zheng, Tongyuan Bai, Feipeng Tian, Zilong Dong, Zihan Zhou, Ping Tan
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, video generation
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Tongyi Lab (Alibaba Group), ManyCore Tech Inc., Jilin University
papers.intro: SpatialCrafter提出了一种两阶段框架，通过从单张图像一次性生成全局3D代理（而非增量重建），再以视频扩散模型作为"生成式延迟细化器"将粗代理细化为逼真的RGB-D视频，从而实现了在极端相机运动和视角变化下仍保持3D一致性的可探索场景生成。

papers.title: A Geometry-Driven, Framework-Agnostic Optimization for Object Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Wei Chen, Tao Zhen, Zhongchen Shi, Jing Zhang, Liang Xie, Erwei Yin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文正文未提供作者机构信息）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于惯性主轴的几何驱动、框架无关的数据级优化方法（π-Mechanism），通过将物体坐标系与固有几何主轴对齐来规范化姿态标注，在不修改任何网络架构的情况下显著提升6D物体姿态估计精度并从根本上消除对称物体的旋转歧义。

papers.title: Generative Semantic Scene Completion
papers.authors: Shi Chen, Weifeng Ge
papers.tags: diffusion model, 3D reconstruction, autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: 复旦大学计算机科学与人工智能学院；Shi Chen同时隶属于卡内基梅隆大学机器人研究所
papers.intro: 本文提出生成式语义场景补全（GSSC）框架，通过统一的离散扩散公式同时实现配对稀疏-稠密场景合成（PS³）、语义引导生成式场景补全（SGSC）和结构化源离散扩散（S²D²）三个功能，在SemanticKITTI隐藏测试集上以单步、无测试时增强达到38.8% mIoU，创下因果单扫描单样本的最佳成绩。

papers.title: Beyond the Proving Ground: Independent Public-Road Testing of Assisted Lane Change Systems using LiDAR
papers.authors: Marcello Cellina, Akos Kriston, Antonio Migneco, Davide Maggi, Stefano Favelli, Fabrizio Re, Fabrizio Minarini, Andrea Nuovo, Riccardo Dona, Biagio Ciuffo
papers.tags: autonomous driving, LiDAR, object detection, tracking, BEV perception
papers.affiliations: European Commission Joint Research Centre
papers.intro: 本研究提出并实施了一种基于LiDAR的独立公共道路测试方法，用于评估商用辅助变道系统是否符合UNECE第79号法规的安全距离要求，首次在法国A31高速公路上完成了针对R79合规性的公共道路测试活动。

papers.title: DPA-I2P: Depth-Guided Projective Alignment for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Wenxin Zhang, Hang Li, Zhiwei Xu, Qiankun Dong, Gang Wang, Tao Li
papers.tags: autonomous driving, pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Nankai University（南开大学）；Haihe Lab of ITAI（海河实验室）
papers.intro: 本文提出DPA-I2P，一种深度引导的投影对齐隐式对应学习框架，通过射线条件度量深度编码（RMDE）、投影一致视觉提升（PVL）和跨模态查询剪枝（CQP）三个模块，构建更具判别力的跨模态特征空间，实现鲁棒的图像到点云配准。

papers.title: Auditable CT Phenotyping Through Report-derived Radiological Observations
papers.authors: Riga Wu, Walter Witschey, Yicheng Li, Felix Barajas Ordonez, Keno K. Bressem, Lisa C. Adams, Gary E. Weissman, Li Shen, Christos Davatzikos, Eduardo Barbosa, Daniel Truhn, Tianyu Han
papers.tags: medical image, multimodal learning, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University Hospital RWTH Aachen, Technical University of Munich, University Hospital Essen
papers.intro: 本文提出可审计CT表型分析（ACT）框架，利用报告派生的放射学观察作为图像标注、表型预测、模型审计和限制的共同语言，揭示了准确CT表型预测可能建立在无效观察上，并能识别和干预这些捷径。

papers.title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding
papers.authors: Yuqiang Lin, Yan Shi, Sam Lockyer, Harish Tayyar Madabushi, Adrian Evans, Wenbin Li, Yinhai Wang, Nic Zhang
papers.tags: video search, object detection, tracking, YOLO
papers.affiliations: University of Bath, University of Washington
papers.intro: TAU-Agent提出了一种基于智能体检索增强的框架，通过主检索智能体协调视频字幕工具和开放词汇跟踪工具来检索查询相关的证据，并由监督微调的视频语言模型进行最终推理和答案生成，以解决交通异常理解任务。

papers.title: When Composition Doesn't Add Up: Humans Identifying Defects in AI-Generated Images
papers.authors: Ruoqi Hu, Chulin Zhao, Jiashuo Chang, Ramon Ruiz-Dolz, Hanhe Lin
papers.affiliations: Dundee International Institute of Central South University, Central South University, China; Faculty of Science, Engineering and Business, University of Dundee, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文通过设计并实施一项大规模主观实验，构建了首个组合性AI生成图像缺陷数据集CO-AID，系统揭示了人类识别AI生成图像中组合性缺陷的机制，并验证了该数据集在缺陷预测和图像生成优化方面的实用性。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language Models Agree on the Affective Qualities of Shape? A Cross-Model Audit for Generative Design Interfaces
papers.authors: Luca Bux, Thiago Rios, Ingo Scholtes, Stefan Menzel
papers.affiliations: Honda Research Institute Europe GmbH（Luca Bux, Thiago Rios, Stefan Menzel）；Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg（Ingo Scholtes）
papers.intro: 本文通过审计6种视觉语言模型在10个ShapeNetCore类别中对无纹理3D物体沿Kansei情感形容词对的排序一致性，提出了一种离线跨模型一致性审计方法，用于在生成式设计界面中决定哪些情感语义控制应被暴露给用户。
